channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que não viu vídeo de Michelle e diz que não tem relação com ex-primeira-dama
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated he has no relationship with former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro, after she released videos accusing him of disrespect and humiliation during a phone call. He denied pressuring her to support his presidential pre-candidacy, saying her support was optional. The conflict stems from a dispute over the PL’s electoral slate in Ceará, with Michelle having resigned from PL Women’s leadership and considering not running for Senate in the Federal District.

item.title: Senado aprova proposta que reduz em quase 40% de floresta no Pará e dificulta multas ambientais
item.description: The Senate approved a bill reducing the Jamanxim National Forest in Pará by 37,39% (from 1.302 million to 814,600 hectares), converting the excluded area into an Environmental Protection Area (APA), which allows land regularization and economic activities such as cattle ranching and mining under partial restrictions. The bill now awaits presidential sanction and has raised environmental concerns over potential increases in deforestation, land grabbing, and illegal mining in the Amazon.

item.title: 'Foi a minha tentativa de sensibilizar o cara', diz Flávio Bolsonaro sobre ida aos EUA para tratar de tarifaço com Trump
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for president from the PL party, stated that his trip to the U.S. to discuss 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods was an attempt to 'sensitize' Donald Trump, denying it was election-motivated. He said he sought to avoid U.S. trade measures regardless of Brazil's electoral outcome. The USTR hearing concludes this Wednesday (15), with the U.S. evaluating a 12.5% tariff (over forced labor) and a 25% tariff (alleging Brazilian practices that burden U.S. trade).

item.title: Flávio: Caiado, Zema e Flávio se atacarem é um desserviço, não vou me prestar a esse papel
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) advocated for unity within the center-right in the 2026 elections, stating he will not engage in criticizing rivals such as Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) and Romeu Zema (Novo), which he views as a disservice to the political project.

item.title: MDB dribla Lula e abre 486 mil hectares de Jamanxim a fazendas e mineração
item.description: In under ten minutes, the MDB in Congress approved a project that reduces environmental protection over 486,438 hectares of the Jamanxim National Forest in Pará, enabling private land regularization and mining. The proposal entered as an extra agenda item, received urgency, and was symbolically approved, overturning a recent effort by President Lula to withdraw a more restrictive version. The operation was orchestrated since May by MDB lawmakers including Jader Barbalho, José Priante, and Isnaldo Bulhões Jr., and takes place just days before the 2026 party conventions.

item.title: Flávio aumenta carga contra STF e diz que corte quer fazer a vez do TSE e interferir em eleição
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) intensified his criticism of the Supreme Federal Court (STF), accusing justices, particularly Alexandre de Moraes, of attempting to interfere in the 2026 elections by assuming roles that belong to the TSE, without providing evidence.

item.title: Site publica foto que mostra Flávio Bolsonaro ao lado de ‘Sicário’ de Daniel Vorcaro
item.description: ICL Notícias published a photo showing pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro alongside Luiz Phillipi Machado de Moraes Mourão, known as 'Sicário', identified by the Federal Police as the leader of the intimidation and coercion unit of Banco Master. The image, taken in 2022 at a hotel in Rio de Janeiro's southern zone, was verified by five AI detection platforms and deemed authentic. Bolsonaro stated he does not recognize the man in the photo and compared the situation to Deolane Bezerra's visit to the Planalto Palace.

item.title: Após virar a casaca de Bolsonaro para Lula, Soraya Thronicke deve desistir de reeleição ao Senado
item.description: Senator Soraya Thronicke (PSB-MS) is expected to withdraw from her Senate re-election bid in 2026 due to poor polling numbers, stemming from her frequent party switches and perceived political inconsistency, including shifting from Bolsonaro supporter to Lula ally. While her team denied the decision is final, they confirmed ongoing negotiations for her to become the substitute for federal deputy Vander Loubet (PT-MS), both aligned with Lula’s base.

item.title: Irmão de Silas Malafaia será suplente de candidato ao Senado do PL
item.description: State deputy Samuel Malafaia, brother of pastor Silas Malafaia, will be the alternate for Carlos Portinho (PL) in the 2026 Senate race in Rio de Janeiro. The decision follows party pressure and Flávio Bolsonaro’s public endorsement of Portinho, who has served as senator since 2020. Samuel Malafaia, in his fifth term in the Alerj, strengthens the PL’s alliance with the Bolsonarist base in the state.

item.title: Corrida presidencial: qual pesquisa está dando a maior vantagem eleitoral para Lula
item.description: Lula leads the 2026 presidential race with advantages ranging from 6 to 12 points in the first round over Flávio Bolsonaro, depending on the pollster. In potential second-round scenarios, his lead varies between 7 and 8 points, with Lula polling between 45% and 49%. The four main polls (Genial/Quaest, BTG/Nexus and others not detailed) confirm his frontrunner status, despite a 2-point margin of error.

item.title: PT nacional força solução e petistas mineiros se sentem desmoralizados
item.description: The announcement by national GTE coordinator of the PT, federal deputy Jilmar Tatto, that Patrus Ananias had been chosen as the party's candidate for governor of Minas Gerais caused discomfort among local leaders, who felt disrespected for not being consulted. Although they support Patrus, state cadres criticized the lack of dialogue with the state leadership. The Minas Gerais PT and Patrus's office have not officially confirmed the candidacy, awaiting a final decision with President Lula.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: o peso dos escândalos recentes na opinião do eleitor, segundo pesquisa
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll reveals that most Brazilians remain unaware of two recent political episodes: the rift between Michelle Bolsonaro and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (51% unaware) and the investigation involving Senator Jaques Wagner (PT) (54% unaware). Among those who saw Michelle Bolsonaro’s video criticizing Flávio, 45% believe she was right to speak out, and 31% consider her statements entirely true. Regarding Wagner’s case, 61% of those informed believe he acted wrongly, and 37% think the scandal could negatively affect Lula’s campaign.

item.title: Trad diz que Vieira irá ao Senado apesar de ausência na Câmara
item.description: Senator Nelsinho Trad (PSD-MS) stated that Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira is expected to attend a Senate session after the parliamentary recess in August, despite failing to appear before a Chamber of Deputies summons. Trad noted Vieira has been invited numerous times before and never absent, making another absence unlikely. The focus is on Vieira explaining his claim that the U.S. designation of CV and PCC as terrorist groups implies a risk of U.S. military action in Brazil — a statement that even prompted a reprimand from President Lula.

item.title: Senado terá semanas de esforço concentrado após o recesso, anuncia Davi
item.description: The Senate will hold two concentrated work weeks in August and September, following the parliamentary recess, to vote on pending proposals, including the PEC to abolish the 6x1 work scale and 57 presidential vetoes, in coordination with the Chamber of Deputies. The announcement was made by Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, aiming for greater efficiency and harmony between the legislative houses ahead of the October elections.

item.title: Moraes encaminha à PGR manifestação de Bolsonaro sobre carta divulgada por Flávio
item.description: Minister Alexandre de Moraes forwarded to the Attorney General's Office the defense's manifestation by former President Jair Bolsonaro regarding the dissemination of a letter read by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro on social media. PGR Paulo Gonet has five days to issue an opinion. The case raises questions about the legality of the document's disclosure.

item.title: AtlasIntel culpa sistema do TSE por erro apontado pelo PL
item.description: AtlasIntel claims the alleged flaws in its July 2026 electoral poll, challenged by the PL before the TSE, stem from technical issues in the TSE's own system, not from missing documentation, as all required files were properly submitted to PesqEle. The poll shows Lula (PT) at 46.3% and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 36.6% in the first round, and 47.2% vs. 36.3% in a potential runoff. The PL seeks to invalidate the poll for alleged lack of registration, but AtlasIntel references a similar case with Vox Brasil, where the TSE confirmed the issue was a system display error.

item.title: Após um mês internado, Cacique Raoni tem alta hospitalar
item.description: Indigenous leader Raoni Metuktire, 93, was discharged from a São Paulo hospital after a month-long stay for intestinal obstruction, aspiration pneumonia, and digestive hemorrhages. His release comes ahead of the 2026 Brazilian elections, underscoring his enduring role as a global symbol of Indigenous and environmental advocacy.

item.title: Crusoé: “AtlasIntel não mudará sua técnica por pressão política”
item.description: The CEO of AtlasIntel, Andrei Roman, stated that the PL's request to annul the poll showing Lula ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro was based on a recurring error in the TSE system, citing recent jurisprudence from Paraná. He affirmed that the institute will not alter its methodology due to political pressure, emphasizing the integrity of its research.

item.title: A resposta do AtlasIntel a mais uma ação do PL contra pesquisa que mostra liderança de Lula
item.description: AtlasIntel denied the PL's allegations that it failed to meet legal requirements in publishing a July poll showing Lula leading Flávio Bolsonaro by 6.6 points, stating the data was submitted on time and that the issue was a technical glitch in the TSE system, not the poll itself. The PL had previously succeeded in suspending another AtlasIntel poll in June over alleged methodological bias.

item.title: Milei celebra classificação da Argentina para a final da Copa: "Carajo"
item.description: Argentine President Javier Milei celebrated on social media Argentina's advancement to the 2026 World Cup final after a 2-1 victory over England, with Lautaro Martínez scoring the winning goal in extra time. He used the exclamation 'Carajo' in an enthusiastic post, highlighting the upcoming final against Spain on July 19. The semifinal was played at Atlanta Stadium in the United States.

item.title: Moraes manda PGR opinar após alegação de defesa de Bolsonaro sobre carta
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes ordered the Attorney General's Office (PGR) to respond after Jair Bolsonaro's defense claimed he had no prior knowledge of the publication of a letter written by him and attributed to his son, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The ruling comes amid investigations into alleged crimes related to the spread of disinformation and abuse of power.

item.title: AtlasIntel nega irregularidade em pesquisa questionada pelo PL no TSE
item.description: AtlasIntel denied irregularities in an electoral poll questioned by the PL before the TSE, stating that all required documents were properly submitted to the PesqEle system and that the lack of public visibility stems from a technical issue in the system. The poll shows Lula with 46.3% and Flávio Bolsonaro with 36.6% in the first round, and Lula leading with 47.2% against Flávio Bolsonaro's 36.3% in a hypothetical runoff.

item.title: Durigan critica tarifaço e diz que governo atenderá setores afetados
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan criticized proposed U.S. tariffs as disproportionate and unjust, stating the Lula government will assess containment measures for affected sectors, including potentially reviving the Reciprocity Law process. He emphasized that the government will not abandon Brazilian farmers, businesspeople, and families, following the same approach used during Trump’s first tariff in July 2025. Durigan also noted the possibility of a new provisional measure to support sectors if tariffs are confirmed.

item.title: Flávio quer que Caixa seja o “Itaú da periferia”, diz Daniella Marques
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) aims to transform Caixa Econômica Federal into an 'Itaú for the periphery', expanding its role beyond social program execution to drive credit access, entrepreneurship, and financial education for low-income populations. The proposal, shared by former bank president Daniella Marques, includes strengthening the 'Brasil por Elas' initiative focused on women's financial autonomy, featuring measures such as childcare vouchers and gender-based violence prevention.

item.title: Moraes manda a PGR se pronunciar sobre carta de Jair Bolsonaro a Flávio
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes ordered the Prosecutor General's Office to respond within five days regarding a letter from former President Jair Bolsonaro to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, which was read aloud during a YouTube live stream. Bolsonaro's defense claimed he did not know the letter would be made public, but Moraes ruled the reading served as premature political promotion, banned until August 16, and requested the Electoral Prosecutor's Office to assess whether it constituted illegal electoral propaganda. The decision may lead to the revocation of Bolsonaro's house arrest.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Genial/Quaest: já está rolando debandada de Flávio?
item.description: The latest Genial/Quaest poll shows President Lula expanding his lead over Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 presidential race, with 26% of spontaneous voting intention versus 14% for Flávio. The result suggests a possible erosion of support for the Bolsonaro-aligned candidate, according to analysis on Papo Antagonista.

item.title: Deputados da direita atuam a favor de lei que complica Zambelli, Ramagem e Eduardo Bolsonaro
item.description: Right-wing deputies in Brazil's Chamber of Deputies actively supported the approval of a legislative text that complicates the political situation of former deputies Carla Zambelli, Alexandre Ramagem, and Eduardo Bolsonaro, all from the PL party. The exclusive subscriber-only report highlights that this internal right-wing maneuver was strategic and immediately affected the electoral viability of these figures. Full access requires registration on the publication's website.

item.title: Moraes pede que PGR se manifeste sobre possível descumprimento de Bolsonaro por carta divulgada por Flávio
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes has requested the Prosecutor General's Office to comment on a possible breach of the social media ban imposed on former President Jair Bolsonaro, following the dissemination of a letter written by Bolsonaro and shared by his son, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. Bolsonaro's defense claimed he was unaware the letter would be made public, but Moraes had previously suspended Flávio's visits for 90 days, suspecting misuse of visitation rights to obtain and distribute the letter. The Prosecutor General has five days to respond, while the Electoral Public Ministry is also assessing whether the disclosure constituted illegal early campaigning in support of Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential pre-candidacy.

item.title: Justiça Eleitoral concede 21 decisões favoráveis a Tarcísio contra fake news
item.description: Brazil's Electoral Court granted 21 preliminary rulings in favor of São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas against boosted ads containing fake news and negative attacks by Workers' Party legislators and anonymous pages. The rulings ordered the immediate removal of the posts, deemed illegal negative electoral propaganda.

item.title: Carta divulgada por Flávio: Moraes dá cinco dias para PGR avaliar se Bolsonaro descumpriu ordem judicial
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes has given the Prosecutor-General’s Office five days to assess whether former President Jair Bolsonaro violated a judicial order by having a letter supporting his son Flávio’s presidential pre-candidacy publicly disclosed, despite the defense claiming Bolsonaro did not authorize its release. Moraes had previously suspended Flávio’s visits to Bolsonaro for 90 days and demanded explanations over potential indirect use of social media, which is barred under current precautionary measures. The defense maintains the letter was written privately during an authorized visit and that Bolsonaro remains committed to complying with all imposed conditions.

item.title: Moraes vai ouvir Gonet sobre carta de Jair Bolsonaro lida em live de Flávio
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes gave the Attorney General's Office five days to respond to Jair Bolsonaro's defense regarding the letter read by his son Flávio in a live stream. The defense claimed Bolsonaro was unaware the document would be made public. Moraes did not express any value judgment in his ruling.

item.title: Tarifaço vira munição do PT para desgastar Flávio com “TariFlávio”
item.description: On July 14, 2026, the PT defined a communication strategy to associate the 25% U.S. tariff on Brazilian products with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), coining the term 'TariFlávio'. The Lula government campaign alleges the Bolsonaro family colluded with Trump allies to drive the trade investigation leading to the tariff, highlighting Flávio's June 2026 U.S. trip where he urged delaying the tariff until after Brazil's elections.

item.title: Ao vivo: PT lança plataforma de mobilização e cartilha para militância
item.description: The PT is launching today in Salvador its national mobilization platform and the Popular Committees of Struggle booklet, aiming to strengthen grassroots organization and support Lula’s 2026 reelection bid. The event features national party president Edinho Silva and will be streamed live on the party’s official channels.

item.title: Diretor da Fundação FHC critica fala de Janja sobre primeiras-damas
item.description: Sergio Fausto, director-general of the FHC Foundation, criticized First Lady Janja's statement that Brazil never had a first lady who worked effectively, calling it a display of historical ignorance. He cited Ruth Cardoso, wife of former president Fernando Henrique Cardoso, as a prominent example of effective first-lady action in poverty alleviation, academia, and international organizations. Janja defended her role as FAO ambassador and in the Feminicide Pact, claiming class bias and media focus on behind-the-scenes narratives over her substantive work.

item.title: Cabeçalho da "carta aos brasileiros" enfraquece versão de Bolsonaro
item.description: The header of the letter read by Flávio Bolsonaro, identifying it as a 'letter to Brazilians,' contradicts Jair Bolsonaro's defense claim that he did not know the document would be made public, weakening his argument before Minister Alexandre de Moraes. Allies admit the defense was weak, but it was the only option to avoid revoking Bolsonaro's house arrest. So far, only Flávio has been punished, banned from visiting his father for 90 days.

item.title: Bolsonaro “jamais soube” que Flávio divulgaria carta, diz defesa
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro stated that the former president never knew that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro would disclose a letter supporting his presidential pre-candidacy. The statement was made in response to a demand from Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, who gave Bolsonaro 48 hours to clarify the matter after the letter’s release.

item.title: Renan Santos ironiza foto de Flávio com “Sicário”: “Dois bandidos”
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Renan Santos (Mission) criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) after sharing a photo of him alongside Luiz Phillipi Machado de Moraes Mourão, known as 'Sicário', whom the Federal Police linked to businessman Daniel Vorcaro. Renan sarcastically called the two 'two bandits' in a social media post on Wednesday, the 15th.

item.title: PL vai ao TSE contra mais uma pesquisa que mostra Lula à frente de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The PL party has filed a complaint with the TSE against an AtlasIntel poll showing Lula leading Flávio Bolsonaro by 6.6 percentage points in a hypothetical 2026 presidential runoff, citing lack of methodological transparency. The party urges the TSE to establish stricter rules for the registration, oversight, and publication of electoral polls, linking this new challenge to an ongoing case regarding a May poll by the same institute.

item.title: “Tarifaço vai destruir quem alimenta o Brasil”, afirma Caiado
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado criticized the federal government and Flávio Bolsonaro for failing to strongly oppose the proposed U.S. tariff hike on Brazilian goods, China's 55% tariff on Brazilian meat, and the EU's ban on Brazilian animal products, claiming these policies will destroy Brazil's agribusiness sector, which 'feeds Brazil'. He accused the government of offering only 'palliative care' and Flávio Bolsonaro of seeking only a delay, not a rejection, of the U.S. tariffs — even if it means letting agribusiness collapse until after the election.

item.title: Foto com ‘Sicário’ amplia o rastro do Caso Master sobre a campanha de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The release of a 2022 photo showing Senator Flávio Bolsonaro alongside Luiz Phillipi Machado de Moraes Mourão, known as 'Sicário' and identified by the Federal Police as the leader of Daniel Vorcaro's bank intimidation group, revives the Master Case scandal and raises new questions about the pre-candidate's ties to figures linked to criminal activities. Mourão, arrested in March and later declared brain-dead, coordinated 'A Turma', responsible for monitoring and intimidating Vorcaro's adversaries. The image, verified by fact-checking tools, shows no signs of AI manipulation.

item.title: Desenrola e debate sobre escala 6x1 ajudam a melhorar aprovação de Lula, diz Quaest
item.description: Government programs under President Lula focused on popular economy, such as Desenrola and the proposed 6x1 work scale, are helping boost his approval ratings ahead of the 2026 re-election campaign, according to Quaest. These measures are resonating positively with low-income groups, reinforcing an image of socially active governance.

item.title: Recuo de líder do governo para agradar a Alcolumbre irrita aliados de Boulos
item.description: The effort by Senate government leader Teresa Leitão (PT-PE) to improve relations with Davi Alcolumbre (União-AP) by restraining criticisms from Guilherme Boulos (PSOL) and other PT members against the Senate president triggered negative reactions among Boulos’ allies in the Planalto Palace. The retreat was perceived as a concession to an opposition-aligned senator, undermining government coalition cohesion.

item.title: Alcolumbre evita dar prazo para promulgar ‘pauta-bomba’, mas sinaliza tempo para governo negociar
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre signaled he will give the government time to negotiate a deal to mitigate the fiscal impact of the PEC granting special retirement to health agents, though he did not commit to delaying promulgation until after the elections. Finance Minister Dario Durigan urged caution and suggested waiting until after the electoral period, but Alcolumbre avoided setting a deadline, stating the PEC will be promulgated when conditions allow. The PEC passed with 73 votes in favor and 1 against, with an estimated fiscal impact of R$ 27 billion, and the government is considering taking the matter to the Supreme Federal Court.

item.title: “O tarifaço vai destruir quem alimenta o Brasil”
item.description: Former Goiás governor and presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) warned that potential new U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods, combined with existing 55% Chinese tariffs on meat and EU bans on Brazilian beef, could destroy the country's food-producing sector. He emphasized that no one is discussing this risk and that the triple trade barrier constitutes a serious threat to Brazil's economy.

item.title: A nova de Nunes Marques: gourmetizar pesquisas eleitorais
item.description: The text ironically references the 'FEBEAPÁ' (Festival of Stupidity Plaguing the Country), created by Sérgio Porto under the pseudonym Stanislaw Ponte Preta in 1964, to criticize the current trend of 'gourmetizing' electoral polls — that is, transforming superficial or biased data into refined, seemingly sophisticated analyses lacking real substance. The critique highlights the manipulation or trivialization of opinion polls in the context of the 2026 Brazilian elections, turning them into media-consumption products rather than tools for genuine political understanding.

item.title: Esquerda explora foto de Flávio com “Sicário” e amplia pressão nas redes
item.description: The left used a photo of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro alongside Luiz Phillipi Machado de Moraes Mourão, nicknamed 'Sicário', to pressure the pre-candidate for president and associate him with alleged ties to businessman Daniel. The image was widely shared on social media by PT and PSOL lawmakers, who demanded explanations and sought to damage Flávio Bolsonaro's reputation.

item.title: As ‘presas’ preferenciais do PL na caçada por uma vice para Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The PL is seeking a presidential ticket for Flávio Bolsonaro and has identified its preferred vice-presidential options: first, an alliance with the PP-União federation, seen as the 'dream ticket,' though facing resistance from the parties' leaderships favoring neutrality; as a Plan B, the PL targets someone from the Republicans party, believing it can persuade its leader, Marcos Pereira, to abandon independence; as a third option, it considers Podemos led by Renata Abreu, which might join the ticket to strengthen its congressional bench.

item.title: Defesa diz que Bolsonaro não sabia que Flávio divulgaria carta
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro stated that he did not know Flávio Bolsonaro would disclose a letter requesting support for his candidacy on social media. The statement responds to a decision by Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes, who banned meetings between father and son for 90 days after the letter's disclosure, a measure deemed illegal by the defense and the OAB, which argues Flávio acts as Bolsonaro's lawyer.

item.title: Mauro Vieira falta à convocação na Câmara e comissão cita crime de responsabilidade
item.description: Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira failed to attend a summons by the Chamber of Deputies’ Foreign Relations and National Defense Committee to clarify issues including Brazil’s stance on classifying criminal factions as terrorist organizations, disclosure of official lodging in diplomatic properties, and the impact of U.S. tariffs on the national economy. The committee voted to issue a formal request for the initiation of a responsibility crime procedure, deeming his absence unjustified. The Itamaraty stated Vieira had notified in advance of a prior meeting with President Lula, but lawmakers dismissed the explanation as vague and insufficient.

item.title: Flávio subscreve petição ao STF que diz que Bolsonaro não sabia que carta seria divulgada por… Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, acting as a lawyer, signed a petition from Jair Bolsonaro's defense team to the STF claiming the former president did not know his letter would be disclosed by Flávio himself. The exclusive report highlights an internal contradiction in the defense strategy.
